sections.text_helper: Section 20.5 "Address space" in chapter 20 (Neural-ART accelerator™ (NPU)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1027.
sections.section_content:
The configuration bus address mapping depends on the specific NPU instance
configuration. Each of the functional units has a 4-Kbyte configuration space, which yields a
128-Kbyte configuration space for the total IP, organized as shown in Table111.
[Table 111. Neural-ART 14 functional units memory base addresses(1)]
